findings.issue: The getter is a keccak of a constant (abi.encode of a literal string: the head 0x20, the length and the padded bytes), yet each prints the hash expression instead of the 32-byte constant, and the notation 'sha3(Array(len, data))' does not show the 0x20 head word that is hashed (text_check confirms the meaning is right).
findings.rule: sha3 of constant memory is a constant: fold it to the 32-byte value (optionally keeping the preimage as a comment, e.g. # keccak256(abi.encode('...'))).
findings.verified: text_check run --per-selector 2: 555 calls same, 0 different; evmrun 0xa89364dc returns 0x0697a21a...266d

notes: A library of 276 public constants: 275 bytes32 keys computed as keccak256(abi.encode(literal)) and one string constant (USER_INITIATED_CANCEL); every ABI function is present (277 defs with the fallback, which reverts), all of the same 2-line shape, all checked against the source names and strings. 'payable' is right for a library (no callvalue check). No loops in the source or the text.
summary: Trivial and fully faithful: every key getter is present; the only possible improvement is folding the constant keccak of each key name to its 32-byte value.
